messages.content: What is the time difference between Los Angeles and Berlin?

message.content:
Los Angeles (Pacific Time) is **9 hours behind** Berlin (Central European Time) for most of the year.  
Both cities observe daylight‑saving time, but because the start and end dates differ, there are short windows when the difference is 8 hours:

| Period | Los Angeles (UTC offset) | Berlin (UTC offset) | Time difference |
|--------|--------------------------|---------------------|-----------------|
| Standard time (winter) | UTC‑8 | UTC+1 | **9 h** |
| Summer (both DST) | UTC‑7 | UTC+2 | **9 h** |
| **March–late March** (US DST starts earlier) | UTC‑7 | UTC+1 | **8 h** |
| **Late October–early November** (Europe DST ends earlier) | UTC‑7 | UTC+1 | **8 h** |

So, unless you’re looking at those brief overlap windows, you can safely assume a 9‑hour time difference, with Berlin ahead of Los Angeles.
